title: DC Current Controller
text: 带积分抗饱和的离散时间 DC 电流 PI 控制，输入 4 路、输出 1 路；{Proportional gain} 控制器比例增益 K p、{Integral gain} 指定积分增益 K i、{Anti-windup gain} 指定抗饱和增益 K aw、{Voltage limitation} 指定负电压限制 Positive and negative、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间、{Discretization sample time} 指定离散化采样时间、{Enable zero cancellation} 指定前馈零消去，按实例取值。

ports.name: v max
ports.summary: 最大 DC 电压 scalar

ports.name: vRef
ports.summary: 参考 DC 电压 scalar

params.name: Proportional gain
params.values: 控制器比例增益 K p 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integral gain
params.values: 积分增益 K i 5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Anti-windup gain
params.values: 抗饱和增益 K aw 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Voltage limitation
params.values: 负电压限制 Positive and negative voltage (default) | Positive voltage only

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Discretization sample time
params.values: 离散化采样时间 0.001 (default) | positive scalar
